surfaceProps.impactStatement: The Factory Acceptance Test Plan procedures (full-load run, insulation tests) are designed for specific motor electrical characteristics. The rating change from 22 kW to 18.5 kW affects current draw, thermal behavior, and test acceptance criteria. Test procedures must be reverified before factory testing proceeds.
surfaceProps.suggestedAssignee: Test engineer or electrical engineer responsible for Atlas FAT

nodes.title: Atlas — Cable Schedule and Sizing Calculations
nodes.rationale: Cable sizing calculations for Atlas. Conductor sizing is directly derived from motor rating but no literal '22 kW' visible in snippet. Calculations must be reverified for 18.5 kW.

surfaceProps.impactStatement: Cable sizing calculations are derived from motor full-load current, which changes with the rating reduction from 22 kW to 18.5 kW. While the 18.5 kW motor draws less current (potentially making existing calculations conservative), all conductor sizing, protection coordination, and voltage drop calculations should be reverified for accuracy and compliance.
surfaceProps.suggestedAssignee: Electrical design engineer responsible for Atlas cable schedule
